name: Show Tap
description: Shows a dot at a configurable screen position while you hold the jump button. It appears on press and disappears on release.

settings-button.name: Show settings button
settings-button.description: Adds a Show Tap button to the pause menu that opens this settings menu.

only-on-jump.name: Only on jump
only-on-jump.description: ON: only the jump button shows the dot. OFF: both the jump button AND tapping the screen show the dot.

only-when-playing.name: Only when playing
only-when-playing.description: ON: the dot only shows while you are playing a level (not in menus, and not while paused). OFF: it can also show in menus. Note: for taps in menus, turn Only on jump OFF.

fade-out.name: Release Fade (ms)
fade-out.description: How long the dot takes to shrink away after you release. 0 removes it instantly.

x-position.name: X Position (%)
x-position.description: Horizontal position: 0 is left, 100 is right.

y-position.name: Y Position (%)
y-position.description: Vertical position: 0 is bottom, 100 is top. Default is slightly below center.

shakiness.name: Shakiness
shakiness.description: Maximum random offset around the X/Y position, in game points. 0 keeps the dot fixed.
